_note: Pre-run config for exp-037 (count-first decomposition arm). Written before any run; the per-run config snapshots the runner writes (runs/exp-037/<arm>/decomposer/<ts>/config.json) are the record of what actually ran and are copied here after the run. ONE change against the paired unguided arm: --condition count_first instead of --condition unguided. Model, 4-bit precision, retrieval artifact (hence the exemplars), few-shot ordering, decoding, seed, step parser and evaluation set are those of exp-020 (Mistral) / exp-027 (Qwen3.5-9B).
design_source: Jev memo at the repo root, section C1.3 'Hop-count-first structured output (self-guided oracle)': annotate exemplars with '[k hops]', the model must emit '[k hops]' first. The memo's format is followed ('[N hops]', not 'Hops: N').

condition.name: count_first
condition.exemplar_count_line: '[N hops]' as the first line of each exemplar's decomposition; N = that exemplar's own gold step count (run_decomposer.py::exemplar_gold_hop_count, the evaluator's splitter src/step_lines.py)
condition.instruction_line: - Before the steps, write the number of steps on its own line as [N hops].  (inserted after '- One step per line.' in the model folder's unguided prompt; nothing else in the template changes)
condition.count_is: self-predicted by the model; NOT the gold count (oracle guidance is exp-004/005, a different question)
condition.parser: src/count_first.py::parse_count_first on the post-processed generation; the count line is removed before 'decomposition' is recorded, so the report card scores the steps only. Rows with an absent/malformed/empty count line are kept and scored; their number is in the decomposer metrics.json count_first.status_counts and rows_without_count.

fixed_from_baseline.retrieval_artifact: runs/exp-014/retrieval/s2_pinned600_imbalanced_rerank_top5.jsonl (sha256 3f95c7dc18c14fc6bea3473f1be5c0d7fb21b7b2f2b2a1175dbfaebb5092fdb0; size2000_imbalanced pool, e5-small-v2 bi-encoder top-20 -> cross-encoder top-5, typed masking; checked by run.sh before every decompose)
fixed_from_baseline.eval_set: ADR 0007 pinned 600 (200/hop), asserted by id by the runner
fixed_from_baseline.step_parser: scaffold_truncate_at ['Task:', 'Answer:'] (ADR 0039; the parser exp-032's re-parse applied to the baselines)

mistral_7b_instruct.why: exp-020 is the 4-bit unguided Mistral arm on this artifact; exp-015 is the same arm at fp16 (precision would move). exp-020 was scored with the old parser, so the comparable reading is exp-032's re-parse (ADR 0039 cross-parser rule).
mistral_7b_instruct.comparator: PRIMARY: the same-machine re-run of the baseline's command; SECONDARY: exp-020 as re-parsed by exp-032 (runs/exp-032/exp-020/eval/eval_per_item.json)

qwen3_5_9b.why: exp-027 is the 4-bit unguided Qwen3.5-9B arm on this artifact; exp-005 is the v1 pool, unquantized - a different axis.
qwen3_5_9b.comparator: PRIMARY: the same-machine re-run of the baseline's command; SECONDARY: exp-027 as re-parsed by exp-032 (runs/exp-032/exp-027/eval/eval_per_item.json; 0/600 rows changed by the re-parse, so equal to exp-027's own eval)

steps: experiments/exp-037/run.sh {mistral_count_first | mistral_unguided_rerun | qwen_count_first | qwen_unguided_rerun | compare | metrics}; ALL FOUR decode steps are required. On Colab via notebooks/exp-037_count_first_colab.ipynb. Decodes are resumable (run_decomposer.py --resume; run.sh resumes an interrupted run dir automatically).

hardware_control._note: The stored baselines ran on an RTX 3090 (docs/compute.md); exp-037 runs on Colab (L4 by default). Greedy 4-bit decoding is not guaranteed to be identical across GPUs and library builds.
hardware_control.reproduced_if: the re-run's recorded 'decomposition' equals the stored baseline's re-parsed 'decomposition' (runs/exp-032/exp-020/reparse/results.json; runs/exp-032/exp-027/reparse/results.json) as exact strings for 600/600 query ids. Anything less is NOT reproduced.
hardware_control.consequence: Declared before any run: the primary pairs are unaffected either way (both arms on the same machine). If a model's control is reproduced, its secondary pair (vs stored) carries the same outputs as the primary. If it is not reproduced, that model's secondary pair is labelled hardware-confounded, and the number of identical decompositions plus the control compare are reported.

holm_families._note: Fixed here before any p-value exists (ADR 0036 item 5). Holm is reported BESIDE the evaluator's uncorrected verdict, never instead of it.
holm_families.F1_primary_overall: primary pairs (mistral_count_first_vs_rerun, qwen_count_first_vs_rerun) x the 8 metrics break_exact_match_rate (McNemar), sari_macro (t), ged_macro (t), chain_validity_macro (t), hop_count_exact_match_rate (McNemar), under_decomposition_rate (McNemar), over_decomposition_rate (McNemar), step_f1_macro (t); overall n=600. Size 16.
holm_families.F2_per_hop: primary pairs x {hop_count_exact_match, under_decomposition} x gold hop {2,3,4}, exact McNemar per stratum (n=200). Size 12.
holm_families.outside_families: the secondary pairs, uncorrected and labelled
holm_families.pre_declared_primary_endpoints: under_decomposition_rate and hop_count_exact_match_rate (memo C3 item 1); the others are secondary. No direction is asserted.

count_accuracy_reported: from the count-first decomposer metrics.json count_first block: status counts; rows with/without a readable count; count == gold hop (all rows and parsed rows, overall and per gold hop); count below/above gold; count == steps emitted; gold x predicted confusion

primary_pairs._note: Declared before any run (code review of ed01caa, 2026-11-27). Both arms of a primary pair run on the same Colab GPU, environment and commit, so the pair moves exactly one factor: the condition.
primary_pairs.mistral_count_first_vs_rerun: mistral_count_first minus mistral_unguided_rerun (exp-020's exact command re-run on the same Colab GPU)
primary_pairs.qwen_count_first_vs_rerun: qwen_count_first minus qwen_unguided_rerun (exp-027's exact command re-run on the same Colab GPU)

secondary_pairs._note: Reported uncorrected and labelled; never the headline.
secondary_pairs.mistral_count_first_vs_exp020: count-first minus the stored exp-020 (3090; read through exp-032's re-parse)
secondary_pairs.qwen_count_first_vs_exp027: count-first minus the stored exp-027 (3090; exp-032's re-parse, 0/600 rows changed)

approval: Jahid approved running this arm in session on 2026-11-27 (memo C1.3); recorded in ADR 0043, which also records the departure from ADR 0041 item 1 ('Tier 0 only, no new arms').
